notes: Topic is squarely in the strategic/analytical lane: sources selected for doctrine, industrial base, great-power competition, and military-history analysis rather than partisan or punditry current events. 'out' exclusions (partisan politics, non-strategic current-events punditry) respected — War on the Rocks, The War Zone, and Breaking Defense are included only for their strategic/defense-program coverage, not general news. All sources verified via check_url DNS/feed probe; bot-blocked or HTML-only domains (CSBA, IISS, SIPRI, ACLED, RAND, CNA, Janes, Defense One) are marked with crawl_root pointing at feed endpoints or primary-page hubs. Academic journals (Elsevier/Nature) are handled via the OpenAlex API registry rather than bot-blocked HTML.
